title: Pukers Ruining Dungeon Idol
description: Pukers Ruining Dungeon Idol — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Chuck McBarris

Quest Type: Search and Destroy

Quest Description: Kill 16 Ice Mutant Pukers in the offs of Frump's Misfortune and recover the Literature they are carrying.

Quest Reward: 18750 gold

Return to: Chuck McBarris

Next Quest Given: Shadows Over Dungeon Idol

Repeatable: No

Tip: A routine mob killing quest. Find them, kill them, collect.
